notes.title: The kitchen is closing
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, I must inform you that in the upcoming days, the doors of Burger Kombat’s kitchen will be closed for new visitors, and the game itself will be removed from the Steam store (most likely, forever).

From the very beginning of development, we were busy with our main project and rushed to release this "game" with the intention to fill it with funny stuff and content updates later. However, over time, the coder lost interest and didn’t want to make updates and didn't want to share the project’s source code so I could handle the updates myself.

We had many ideas and plans for future updates to this "game," but things turned out the way they did, and now Burger Kombat is being archived in gaming history.

If you wanted to earn the "platinum" trophy and unlock all achievements, now it's the exact time, as I’m not sure the marketplace will remain functional after the game is removed from Steam. As for item removal, I’ll try to negotiate with the coder to at least release a patch that will allow deleting any items from the Burger Kombat inventory.

Thank you for playing the game, thank you for unlocking achievements, writing reviews, and creating guides.

We (and hopefully you) had fun - and that’s what matters most! 
Stay safe, love your parents and eat well!

notes.title: Burger Kombat — Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Chefs![/h1]

After a long wait, the doors of our kitchen are finally open to each of you. Take your workstations and start assembling the tastiest [b]Burgers [/b]in the world!

To celebrate the opening of the [b]"Burger Kombat"[/b] kitchen for all new Chefs, we have requested increased ingredient supplies. For the next two weeks, [i]new ingredient deliveries will occur every 45 minutes[/i] so that you can prepare as many Burgers as possible. Don't forget to share your culinary successes, to the envy of other chefs!

Our Kitchen has just opened, and we want to make it better and cooler! Therefore, if you have any ideas or suggestions, don't hesitate to write to us at: fourguysoneburger@gmail.com


Also, don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pNTxZfmv5x]Discord[/url] server.

Thank you for your interest in our kitchen and happy cooking!
